title: LLM Query Scheduling with Prefix Reuse and Latency Constraints
authors: Gregory Dexter; Shao Tang; Ata Fatahibaarzi; Qingquan Song; Tejas Dharamsi; Aman Gupta
venue_full: 39th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025)
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Under RadixAttention prefix caching, common online schedulers (FCFS, Longest-Prefix-Match) can produce large TTFT spikes under bursty traffic, but their behaviour with respect to TTFT latency constraints has not been characterised. FCFS misses prefix-reuse opportunities; LPM greedily maximizes cache reuse but can starve queries that lack high prefix overlap, hurting tail TTFT.
problem_statement.zh: 於 RadixAttention prefix caching 之下，常見的線上 scheduler (FCFS、Longest-Prefix-Match) 在突發流量下會產生大幅 TTFT 突波，但對 TTFT 延遲約束的行為尚未被刻畫。FCFS 錯失 prefix-reuse 機會；LPM 雖貪婪追求 cache reuse，卻可能餓死缺乏高 prefix overlap 的查詢，惡化 tail TTFT。

key_innovation.en: A formal computational model of RadixAttention-based LLM inference and proof that deciding feasibility of a TTFT constraint under prefix reuse is NP-Hard (via reduction from 3-PARTITION). Proposes k-LPM, a scheduling algorithm that interleaves k-1 greedy LPM steps with one FCFS step (processing the oldest query), generalizing FCFS (k=1) and LPM (k=infty). Under a tree-structured data generative model with regular arrivals, k-LPM provably achieves max TTFT <= T + n(u/k + d - s/k), strictly better than both LPM and FCFS for intermediate s.
key_innovation.zh: 建立 RadixAttention 式 LLM 推理的形式化計算模型，並證明在 prefix reuse 下判定能否滿足 TTFT 約束為 NP-Hard (由 3-PARTITION 約化)。提出 k-LPM 排程演算法：以 k-1 步貪婪 LPM 加 1 步 FCFS (處理最舊查詢) 交錯，當 k=1 退化為 FCFS、k=infty 退化為 LPM。在 tree-structured data generative model 與固定到達間隔下可證明 k-LPM 滿足 max TTFT <= T + n(u/k + d - s/k)，在中等 s 下嚴格優於 LPM 與 FCFS。

baselines_compared: FCFS, LPM (Longest Prefix Match, SGLang default)

key_improvements.en: k-LPM with k=2 achieves reduced P99 TTFT across a wide range of request rates compared to FCFS and LPM (Figure 2). FCFS P99 TTFT grows ~linearly past 30 RPS while k-LPM stays within ~50 s; under burst-traffic theoretical analysis k-LPM retains a 1/k factor of the sn reduction in TTFT over FCFS. Also gives an approximation algorithm certifying (1-p)-percentile TTFT <= T in O(n * exp(1/p log(1/p))) time.
key_improvements.zh: k=2 的 k-LPM 在廣泛 request rate 區間相較 FCFS 與 LPM 均達成更低的 P99 TTFT (Figure 2)。FCFS P99 TTFT 超過 30 RPS 後近線性成長，k-LPM 仍維持約 50 s 上下；於 burst-traffic 之理論分析下，k-LPM 相較 FCFS 保有 sn reduction 的 1/k 因子。並提供保證 (1-p)-percentile TTFT <= T 的近似演算法，複雜度為 O(n * exp(1/p log(1/p)))。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (theorems give worst/expected-case bounds rather than empirical MAPE; experiments validate that k-LPM beats FCFS and LPM on P99 TTFT)
validation_workloads: 360Brew prompt set (Team 2025) - 2100 prompts, 8K context, structure (Instruction)(MemberProfile)(PastInteractions)(Question); SGLang serving benchmark with Poisson arrivals

scope_assumptions.en: Computational model assumes batch size of one and that only the most recently processed prompt's KV cache is reused (single-prompt cache rather than full RadixAttention memory pool); focuses on prefill-dominated regime where self-attention or FFN dominates. Theoretical guarantees rely on a height-2 tree-structured prompt generative model with regular arrivals and uniform user-doc edge lengths; relaxations (overlap among user/doc substrings, non-uniform repetitions) are acknowledged as gaps. Decoding length and TPOT constraints are not modelled.
scope_assumptions.zh: 計算模型假設 batch size 為 1 且僅重用最近處理過的 prompt 之 KV cache (單 prompt cache 而非完整 RadixAttention memory pool)；聚焦 prefill 主導 regime，self-attention 或 FFN 為主要成本。理論保證基於高度為 2 的 tree-structured prompt 生成模型、固定到達間隔與均勻 user-doc edge 長度；overlap 與不均勻重複等放寬條件被列為留待未來工作的差距。Decoding length 與 TPOT 約束未納入模型。
